hypothesis: Passing the existing count/time-window occurrence aggregate to the sparse relation improves event learning because direct current-last-event routes to the target are absent on some examples.
package_selection: The GPU driver requires explicit CELLERATOR_SPARSE_SUPPORT_SNAPSHOT and CELLERATOR_SPARSE_SUPPORT_EXPECTED_IDENTITY_SHA256 values; it verifies the identity digest plus the frozen runner, module, and extension hashes. No snapshot metadata is edited.
initial_failure: Prototype-only history accumulator used FP16 zeros with FP32 embedding sources in index_add_. Failed before epoch 0 completed; cleanup_verified=true. Retried after changing only accumulator dtype to embedding dtype.
pairing: Within each support/control condition, both readout models use identical initial parameter vectors, exact same fixture tensors, gate context and threshold, optimizer and update schedule.
history_relation_input: Reconstruct from provider work[4], the per-cell source occurrence rows already filtered by the fixture's public count/time window and already used to build gate context. Duplicate occurrences are summed, matching existing history_input semantics.
primary_metric: Unmasked top-1 accuracy over all 24 logits on the fixed 512-cell held-out fixture; report all-24 CE, prediction counts, confusion rows and target ranks.
prior_reporting: Report held-out target class counts and empirical majority-class constant predictor; preserve the full 24-logit training/evaluation domain and do not target-mask.
